title: A plan that adds a skill-text sentence fixes the step it sits in, so the worker asks no placement gate
goal: kb-sprint plan says the goal of an item that adds one sentence to a skill names the step and the neighbouring sentence it follows, since a worker asks a blocking gate for the placement of a rule-guarding file

run:
import sys,pathlib
t=pathlib.Path('skills/sprint/SKILL.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8').lower()
miss=[w for w in ['placement of the sentence'] if w not in t]
sys.exit('not yet: skills/sprint/SKILL.md lacks '+', '.join(miss) if miss else 0)

notes: SP-moxpl354: four of the thirteen items (ST-h2bxcrcd, ST-rosm4sdw, ST-525ypepb, ST-4wlxi33c) stopped on a blocking agents-rule gate about where a sentence or rule sits; each cost a worker pause and the orchestrator's answer.
